auxiliary_lanes.scope: Decoded saved PATH transfer witnesses, flat progressive lane changes, contiguous parallel auxiliary lanes, and both unchanged native through spines beside each parallel section.

model_seams.scope: Car-lane pavement collars at inter-component joins; full barriers, supports, texture alpha, and game rendering remain separate.

supports.scope: Saved vertical faces, indexed road-plane contacts, and conservative saved-PATH car corridors; structural load capacity and in-game collision behaviour are unverified.

barrier_mouths.coverage_limit: Continuous indexed-triangle coverage of 160 independent barrier-joint cross-sections in each proper rotation; this is not all-model manifold closure, every possible intervening surface point, or an in-game observation.

shoulder_uvs.coverage_limit: Affine native U in the 3.9–7.15 m shoulder window outside the half-metre band and independently derived route corridors (1 mm mask guard), plus three erased-line samples per mouth; new corridor UV/phase and native RGB require affirmative separate checks, original V preservation requires the before/after subface audit, and game appearance is unverified.

markings.coverage_limit: Bounded saved triangle-union widths, reviewed gore/mainline centres, hatch angles, acute noses, and near-seam point continuity at four mouths; this does not certify every stroke point, full polygon/barrier clearance, native filtered fringes, or game appearance.

wheeltracks.coverage_limit: Safe indexed asphalt crops, independent saved-PATH even-odd corridor membership, 28 measured seam UV/phase controls, 24 neutral inner-boundary controls, and five former grey-lobe locations; actual RGB, continuous field appearance, and game rendering require separate evidence.

limits: Arm reachability does not establish every possible lane-to-lane transfer or game lane choice.
Pavement seam samples do not certify complete barrier profiles, complete collision envelopes, or texture-alpha coverage.
Ground junction priority and traffic conflicts, construction overrides, shadows, bulldozing, and save/reload require separate game observations.

completed_build_binding.measurement_execution: The direct saved-assembly audit ran on the completed candidate after the current exporter and input-scope verification. Its measurements were not imported from the earlier snapshot run.
